title: TriMet District Boundary
description: TriMet district boundary. 1 Polygon feature covering TriMet's service district in the Portland, Oregon metropolitan area, published by TriMet as `tm_boundary` and last updated at the source on January 09, 2013. This is a cloud-native mirror: the same data as GeoParquet and PMTiles, reprojected to WGS84 from TriMet's NAD83(HARN) / Oregon North (ft). The original Shapefile, KML and metadata page are linked as assets. Column descriptions and code lists are TriMet's own, taken from https://developer.trimet.org/gis/meta_tm_boundary.shtml.

providers.name: TriMet

data.title: TriMet District Boundary (GeoParquet)
data.description: TriMet district boundary. Reprojected to WGS84 from TriMet's NAD83(HARN) / Oregon North (ft) source, Hilbert-ordered, zstd-compressed, with a GeoParquet 1.1 bbox covering column for row-group pruning.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WGS84 longitude and latitude. Reprojected from TriMet's EPSG:2913 (NAD83(HARN) / Oregon North (ft)).

table:columns.name: geometry_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float not null, ymin: float not null, xmax: float not null, ymax: float not null>

visual.title: TriMet District Boundary (PMTiles)
visual.description: Vector tiles for web display, layer name `district-boundary`. Built with tippecanoe keeping every feature at every zoom, so what a map draws matches the GeoParquet exactly.

thumbnail.title: TriMet District Boundary preview
thumbnail.description: Rendered from this collection's styles/default.json with MapLibre GL Native, over a light basemap. WebP is allowed for thumbnails by spec PR portolan-sdi/portolan-spec#121, which this catalog targets; Portolan 0.1 alone permits only PNG and JPEG.

style.title: TriMet District Boundary
style.description: The TriMet service district as a tinted fill with a TriMet-orange edge. The fill uses TriMet's own basemap water tint at low opacity so the district reads as an area without hiding a basemap underneath.

style-context.title: TriMet District Boundary — solid context
style-context.description: A solid, opaque fill in TriMet's basemap building gray. Use this as a backdrop underneath the stop and route layers when no basemap is available, so the network has a visible service area behind it.

style-outline.title: TriMet District Boundary — outline only
style-outline.description: The district edge with no fill, for overlaying on top of other layers without tinting what is underneath.

source_shapefile.title: TriMet District Boundary — original TriMet Shapefile
